scope.statement: Each of the six exact PR #95 sparse-exceptional-stress sources is excluded from global minimality of D(N) by a same-cardinality unit-separated packing of strictly smaller diameter.
scope.domain: The six finite radii R in {16,25,36,64,100,256}; the comparator is a full rational unit-lattice disk of radius R-1/2.
scope.limitations: No claim for other radii or arbitrary canonical Type-II global sources. No stress-mass bound, source-preserving motion, asymptotic exclusion, or canonical promotion.

result: All six exact populations fit inside the comparator disk; its diameter is 2R-1 while the fixture diameter is 2R.
